---
title: "Overview"
---

Where OpenGWASDB stands: what the registry holds, what each epic changed, and
what the engine can do.

This page is the site's home and is filled by #391: milestone progress, each
workstream's active epics with their Next line, and headline numbers with
trends. Until then:

- **[Reports](reports.qmd)** lists the published reports: curation, trait
  mapping, imputation filters and the October 2026 progress update.
- **[Registry](reference.qmd)** holds this repository's decisions,
  specifications and guides, and the
  [glossary](glossary.md) (`CONTEXT.md`, staged at render time).
- **[Engine](opengwasdb/index.qmd)** holds opengwasdb's own documentation,
  rendered from the revision `pixi.lock` pins, so it describes the runtime the
  registry imports.

Links from these pages to files outside `docs/` (a module under `src/`, a
specification fragment under `resources/`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`) point at GitHub at
the commit being rendered.
